definitions: A great commotion or excitement over a trivial or minor matter.
A situation in which a lot of anger or worry is expressed about something that is not important.
examples: The whole argument about the color of the new office chairs was just a tempest in a teapot.
Don't worry about their disagreement; it's just a tempest in a teapot that will blow over soon.
The media created a tempest in a teapot over the celebrity's minor gaffe.
